entities.name: Edin Atić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edin Atić is a Bosnian professional basketball player for Bosna of the Bosnian League and the ABA League. Standing at 6 ft 7 in and weighing 195 lbs. (88 kg), Atić is mainly a shooting guard-small forward, but he can also play as a point forward. He also represents the senior Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team.
